integrity: The manuscript states an analytically proved quasi-norm estimate, its exact extremal profile and a reproducible finite checker. No independent audit, human verification or certified uniqueness of publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp multiplier norm and extremizers are determined for the one-row/one-column binary Schur mask on complex Schatten ideals 0<p<=1 in Hilbert-space dimension at least two. Multiple rows/columns, arbitrary signs and p>1 are not classified; published priority of an equivalent older finite-matrix inequality cannot be ruled out. Finite diagnostic checks are supplementary to the infinite-dimensional proof.
title: Sharp quasi-Schatten norms of the minimal row–column Schur projection
